## What does Tokito Dev do?

Tokito Dev designs and builds fast, minimal frontend interfaces — responsive websites with React.js and Tailwind CSS, and cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo.

## Notable projects

- **TokitoGPT** — AI chatbot web app (React, Tailwind, Vite). Live: https://tokitogpt.netlify.app/
- **Giyu AI** — React Native chatbot themed on Giyu Tomioka with emotion-based sticker replies
- **YT Notes Maker** — YouTube learning companion with notes, quizzes and social learning (React Native, Expo)
- **Post Generator** — AI content creator with 1080x1080 image generation (Node.js, Sharp, OpenRouter API)
- **Insta Auto Post** — AI Instagram auto-poster (Python, Node.js, Instagram API)
